description: Read-only search: judgment routes a request to ripgrep or ast-grep. Pass the user question, agent task, or code-analysis goal; the intent, search strategy, and tool are judged, not specified by the caller. Use search_files/grep when you already know the literal text or glob. Runs on the local filesystem, not a sandboxed task environment. Results may be partial — not evidence of absence.
name: judgrg

query.description: The user question, agent task, or code-analysis goal. Naming a symbol or a called function is enough; a full code pattern such as `foo($X)` is used verbatim for structural search.
